Text A. We are going to walk one kilometre to the lake on Saturday. Bring lunch and water. If it rains, we may eat in the small visitor centre. Families can join free of charge. The walk starts at ten.

Text B. Try camping in the park on Friday night with an adult. You can rent a tent from us. Bring a warm sleeping bag: nights may be cold. We are going to learn about the stars after dinner. Book before Thursday.

Text C. Explore the park with our photographer on Sunday morning. We are going to take pictures of flowers and clouds. No camera? Use a phone. We finish before lunch. The paths may be wet, so wear strong shoes.
